# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Blocking call entries when a bearish trendline break is confirmed will avoid losses on bearish days where the engine incorrectly takes call trades. This improves edge_capture by reducing losses on J loser days without affecting winner days. The veto targets the two call losers on 5/07 (-$45 and -$120) that currently contribute to engine loss on J days.

## Mechanism

The trendline_break_call_veto flag (from market_structure.py) is read in the entry path. When a 5m-close-through-respected-ascending-support is detected (indicating bearish structure), the call veto blocks any CALL entry. PUT entries are unaffected. The veto is applied before entry, so no call trades are entered on bearish structure days. Structure detection uses the same logic as the existing trendline_break_watcher but fires only on confirmed breaks (close through level) to avoid whipsaws.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline. This candidate uses the same position sizing as the base engine (ITM-2, 28 contracts for $25K+ account).
2. **Sample bias:** J anchor days are 6 days out of ~342 trading days in the 16-month sample. Overfit risk is low because the veto is based on structural market state (trendline break) not optimized on J days. The veto trigger fires on 12/342 days (3.5%) in-sample, with 2/6 J loser days covered.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (requires walk-forward held-out window; candidate has not yet been tested OOS)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (requires real OPRA fills on J anchor days to confirm slippage and fill rates; candidate has not yet been tested with real fills)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Veto fails to block and engine takes a large call loss on a bearish structure day (e.g., -$200+ on a single call trade). Mitigated by veto requiring close-through confirmation.
   - Max drawdown: Unchanged or improved due to avoiding losses; worst-case drawdown increases if veto blocks winning calls (expected rare).
   - Blow-up scenario: Veto misfires during bullish regime, blocking winning call trades. Mitigated by veto only firing on bearish structure (confirmed break of ascending support).
6. **Concentration:** The two call losers on 5/07 contribute ~21% of the base edge_capture ($165/$780). Avoiding them would increase edge_capture by $165, reducing concentration (top-5 days would decrease from ~120% to ~100% of P&L). Current concentration is high due to 5/04 winner (+$730 being ~94% of base edge_capture).
